name: autodesk-mcp
description: Read and edit the Revit or AutoCAD 2022-2027 model open on this PC.
long_description:
Lets Claude work with live Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD 2022-2027 sessions on this Windows PC: read projects and drawings, fill parameters, create walls, layers and geometry, insert blocks, and run short C# scripts.

Installing this extension also installs the Revit and AutoCAD add-ins for every year found on this PC, into your own user folders (no administrator rights). Restart Revit or AutoCAD afterwards so they load the add-in.

Everything stays on this computer: Claude talks to Revit and AutoCAD through a local pipe that only your Windows account can open.

install_addins.title: Install Revit/AutoCAD add-ins
install_addins.description: Each time Claude starts, copy the add-ins into your Revit and AutoCAD add-in folders for every year installed on this PC (only changed files are copied). Turn off if IT installs the add-ins another way.

allow_modifications.title: Allow changes to models and drawings
allow_modifications.description: Off = read-only: Revit and AutoCAD refuse every tool that changes a model or drawing. Restart Revit/AutoCAD after changing this.

allow_code_execution.title: Allow C# scripts
allow_code_execution.description: Lets Claude run C# code inside Revit and AutoCAD with your Windows rights. Restart Revit/AutoCAD after changing this.

main_thread_timeout_seconds.title: Busy timeout (seconds)
main_thread_timeout_seconds.description: How long a request waits while Revit/AutoCAD is busy (open dialog, running command) before it is cancelled. It never runs late.
